description: This file defines database service functions for retrieving videos and categories from a database using SQLAlchemy ORM. It includes functions to list videos with optional filtering, retrieve a specific video by ID, and list all categories.

methods.name: List[Video] list_videos(db: Session, q: Optional[str] = None, category_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Video objects from the database, optionally filtered by a search query and/or category ID.

methods.name: Optional[Video] get_video(db: Session, video_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single Video object by its ID, including its associated categories.

methods.name: List[Category] list_categories(db: Session)
methods.description: Returns all Category objects ordered by name.

ctags.name: list_videos
ctags.pattern: /^def list_videos(db: Session, q: Optional[str] = None, category_id: Optional[int] = None) -> List/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, q: Optional[str] = None, category_id: Optional[int] = None)
